name: kdp-niche-scorer-mcp
description: Score Amazon Kindle Direct Publishing (KDP) niches using real-time Amazon search data. Feed a keyword, get demand score (0-100), competition analysis, BSR ranges, pricing data, and top-competitor breakdown. Built for AI agents doing market research for self-publishing.

tools.name: score_niche
tools.description: Score a KDP keyword niche on real Amazon Kindle search data. Returns a 0-100 demand/competition score, BSR ranges, estimated monthly revenue, and top competitor breakdown.

keyword.description: KDP keyword to analyze (e.g. 'low content journal', 'tarot for beginners')

marketplace.description: Amazon country code: US, UK, DE, CA, AU (default US)

royalty_mode.description: Royalty calculation mode: 'kindle' (70%, default) or 'paperback' (60% minus print cost)

tools.name: get_top_competitors
tools.description: Get top Kindle competitor books for a keyword with BSR, price, review count, and estimated monthly revenue.

tools.name: estimate_sales_from_bsr
tools.description: Estimate monthly Kindle sales from an Amazon Best Sellers Rank (BSR) number.
